caption: The drawing depicts a single cowboy boot with a spur attached. The boot is rendered in shades of dark brown and black, with some lighter tan highlights near the top, indicating wear and texture. The spur is metallic gray with a greenish and yellowish hue on the band encircling the boot, and the metal part curves downward along the heel. The composition centers the boot on a plain, cream-colored background with no additional objects or scenery, and the artist's signature “R.W.R. TAYLOR” is visible in small red letters near the lower right corner.
title: Convict Boot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
